projects.name: Olifants River Basin Wastewater Treatment and Reuse

basicData.projectName: Olifants River Basin Wastewater Treatment and Reuse
basicData.projectDescription: This project focuses on improving wastewater treatment capacity and promoting water reuse in the Olifants River Basin, addressing water scarcity and pollution challenges.
basicData.projectLocation: Lephalale, Limpopo, South Africa (with interventions throughout the basin)
basicData.projectOwner: Department of Water and Sanitation, South Africa
basicData.purpose: Improve water quality, reduce pollution, and enhance water security in the Olifants River Basin.
basicData.projectBriefOrFeasibilityStudy: Studies conducted in 2022 highlighted significant water quality issues and the potential for wastewater reuse in the basin.
